caption:
For Neapolitan-style pizza the stone has to reach roughly 750°F or more; lower-temperature units suit New York style or frozen pizza. Most countertop units cap at about 12 inches. Claude and GPT choose the same product: Breville BPZ820BSS. https://1billionmodels.com/home-and-kitchen/kitchen-and-dining/kitchen-small-appliances/ovens-and-toasters/countertop-pizza-ovens?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer
